observations: Photos 0 and 1: the same blue plastic drum, the full-size type usually sold as 200 to 220 litres, standing on bare ground in a yard with other drums and jerrycans.
The top has been cut across and part of it refitted as a flap held by three metal hinges, which are visibly rusted.
Two white screw caps sit in the bung holes on the top.
The sides are heavily scuffed with green paint or residue marks; a 'this way up' arrow mark is moulded on the side.
No label, embossed capacity, food grade mark or previous contents label is readable.
The bottom, inside and the far side are not shown; no water-fill test shown.
Watermark reads 'POSTED ON JIJI SAIVET NIGERIA ENTERPRISE', a dealer handle.

identity.kind: blue plastic drum, about 200 to 220 litres, with cut hinged lid
read_from: photo 0 drum shape and bung caps
photo 1 cut top with three hinges

claims.evidence: A sales slogan, not a fact about this drum.
No food grade mark, resin code or previous contents label visible in photos 0 or 1.

claims.claim: Used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: Photos 0 and 1 show a top cut and refitted with now-rusted hinges, heavy scuffing and green residue, which point to longer use and modification.
Bottom and inside not shown; no water-fill test. The cut top means it is not sealed at the top.
Photos 0 and 1 show both bung caps in place and the hinged flap fitted.

risks.risk: Drum previously held chemicals and is not safe for drinking water or food
risks.proof: Close-up of any moulded markings and resin code on the drum, plus a photo of the inside with the lid open
risks.if_unproven: as a non food grade drum for general storage only

risks.risk: Cracks or pinholes in the base or lower sides
risks.proof: A clip of the drum filled with water and left standing, showing the base and sides dry
Photo looking inside with the flap open in daylight
risks.if_unproven: as needing cleaning, non food grade

risks.risk: Rusted hinges failing and the flap lid not closing tightly
risks.proof: Close-up of the hinges and a clip opening and closing the flap

risks.risk: Capacity smaller than a full-size drum
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure along the height
risks.if_unproven: as the smaller common drum size

proof_requests: Photo inside the drum with the flap open
Close-up of any moulded markings, capacity and resin code
Clip of the drum filled with water showing no leak at the base
Close-up of the hinges and the flap closing
response.reason: The photos clearly show a modified blue plastic drum with a cut hinged lid, priced by type. Until proven otherwise it is priced as a non food grade, possibly leaking storage drum.
